question: Which of the following is the second nearest star to Earth?
solution:
**The correct answer is __Proxima Centauri__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Proxima Centauri:

 
 
• Proxima Centauri is a red dwarf star located in the constellation of Centaurus.
 
• At approximately 4.24 light-years from Earth, it is the closest known star to the Solar System.
 
• Despite its proximity, Proxima Centauri is not visible to the naked eye due to its faintness.
 
• This star is part of the Alpha Centauri star system, which includes Alpha Centauri A and Alpha Centauri B, two brighter stars.
